title: الإجازات الرسمية في المملكة العربية السعودية بالتقويمين الهجري والميلادي (2001–2030)
description: Public, non-working official holidays (الإجازات الرسمية) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia from 2001 through 2030, following the Umm al-Qura calendar (تقويم أم القرى) and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development decrees. Covers the canonical Saudi holiday set: عطلة عيد الفطر (Eid al-Fitr Holiday — 3-day or 4-day depending on whether the preceding Ramadan is a 30-day 'long' month), يوم عرفة (Arafat Day, 9 Dhū al-Ḥijjah), عطلة عيد الأضحى (Eid al-Adha Holiday — 3-day, with compensatory days for weekend overlap), يوم التأسيس (Founding Day, 22 February, established annually since 2022 by royal order), and اليوم الوطني (National Day, 23 September, established as a public holiday since 2005). Observed-day compensation follows the Saudi weekend rule (THU/FRI before 2013-06-28; FRI/SAT thereafter). Each record carries dual Hijri+Gregorian dates (year/month/day plus Arabic Umm al-Qura month name and English month name via hijridate), Arabic + English weekday names, an is_weekend_sa flag (era-aware), an is_observed flag (TRUE for compensatory carry-over days), and an is_estimated flag (TRUE for years ≥ 2026 where the Eid al-Fitr / al-Adha Gregorian projection is computed via Umm al-Qura extrapolation beyond vacanza's confirmed range of 2001–2025). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/saudi_arabia.py, which cites the Arabic-language Wikipedia article 'قائمة العطل الرسمية في السعودية', the Saudi Labor Education portal (laboreducation.hrsd.gov.sa), and a 2022 royal-order announcement establishing Founding Day. Multilingual names in Arabic (ar, native default), English-US (en_US), and Bengali (bn — supported upstream to serve the large South-Asian expatriate workforce in the Gulf).

meta.title: الإجازات الرسمية في المملكة العربية السعودية بالتقويمين الهجري والميلادي (2001–2030) - تحميل مجاني
meta.description: Public, non-working official holidays (الإجازات الرسمية) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia from 2001 through 2030, following the Umm al-Qura calendar (تقويم أم القرى) and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development decrees. Covers the canonical Saudi holiday set: عطلة عيد الفطر (Eid al-Fitr Holiday — 3-day or 4-day depending on whether the preceding Ramadan is a 30-day 'long' month), يوم عرفة (Arafat Day, 9 Dhū al-Ḥijjah), عطلة عيد الأضحى (Eid al-Adha Holiday — 3-day, with compensatory days for weekend overlap), يوم التأسيس (Founding Day, 22 February, established annually since 2022 by royal order), and اليوم الوطني (National Day, 23 September, established as a public holiday since 2005). Observed-day compensation follows the Saudi weekend rule (THU/FRI before 2013-06-28; FRI/SAT thereafter). Each record carries dual Hijri+Gregorian dates (year/month/day plus Arabic Umm al-Qura month name and English month name via hijridate), Arabic + English weekday names, an is_weekend_sa flag (era-aware), an is_observed flag (TRUE for compensatory carry-over days), and an is_estimated flag (TRUE for years ≥ 2026 where the Eid al-Fitr / al-Adha Gregorian projection is computed via Umm al-Qura extrapolation beyond vacanza's confirmed range of 2001–2025). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/saudi_arabia.py, which cites the Arabic-language Wikipedia article 'قائمة العطل الرسمية في السعودية', the Saudi Labor Education portal (laboreducation.hrsd.gov.sa), and a 2022 royal-order announcement establishing Founding Day. Multilingual names in Arabic (ar, native default), English-US (en_US), and Bengali (bn — supported upstream to serve the large South-Asian expatriate workforce in the Gulf). يحتوي على 356 سجل. تحميل بصيغ Excel, CSV, PDF.
